description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for the internal WebAudioPlayerServer component within the Rialto server, including factory creation methods, the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal class with its methods and member variables, and related interfaces for audio playback control, buffer management, and threading.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WebAudioPlayer and WebAudioPlayerServerInternal.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
classes.description: Implementation of the IWebAudioPlayer and IGstWebAudioPlayerClient interfaces, managing WebAudio playback, buffer handling, and interaction with GStreamer.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a WebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a WebAudioPlayerServerInternal instance with specified parameters, including shared memory buffer and handle.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal with client, MIME type, priority, config, shared memory, handle, thread and factory dependencies.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts audio playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses audio playback.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device capabilities such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the client.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies the client of a state change.

methods.name: initWebAudioPlayerInternal
methods.description: Initializes the WebAudioPlayer internal components.

methods.name: initGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: writeBufferInternal
methods.description: Handles internal buffer writing, to be called on the main thread.

methods.name: writeStoredBuffers
methods.description: Transfers stored buffer data to GStreamer.

methods.name: updateAvailableBuffer
methods.description: Updates buffer availability info after writing.

methods.name: handleWriteDataTimer
methods.description: Handles timer timeout for writing data.

methods.name: getQueuedFramesInShm
methods.description: Returns the number of frames queued in shared memory.
